exposure: CCL17/thymus- and activation-regulated chemokine (cord blood serum levels)
Thymus stromal lymphopoietin (cord blood serum levels)
cohort: The study included 40 consecutive full-term newborns from a single university hospital in Pisa, Italy.
finding: Cord blood serum levels of CCL17 and IL-31 were significantly higher in newborns who developed AD by 6 months, and infants with AD also showed statistically significant higher anterior cubital fossa TEWL values at 1, 6, and 12 months.
